title.narrative: Strengthened capacity of member States to ratify and apply international labour standards and to fulfil their reporting obligation

description.narrative:
India has ratified 47 ILO Conventions, including 6 of 10 Fundamental and 3 Governance Conventions. However, critical International Labour instruments remain unratified, notably C29, C87, C98, C155, and C187. Key labour standards under prolonged discussion include Conventions on freedom of association, collective bargaining, occupational safety, domestic workers, violence and harassment, wages and forced labour. Despite efforts, the progress towards ratification has been slow. While India has met its reporting obligations to the ILO supervisory bodies, it can strengthen the implementation of the ratified standards and the CEACR recommendations. India is also recommended to consider ratification of the up-to-date standards to replace earlier ratified outdated and abrogated Conventions. The ILO Governing Body has urged India to prioritize ratification of up-to-date instruments like C155, P155, C161, C176, and C187, C102 and C121.
CPO Strategy 2026-2027 will drive targeted advocacy to revitalize tripartite dialogue and push for priority ratifications, focusing on P29, C87, C98, C155, and C187. Efforts would include organising sensitization events, enhancing technical capacities, and preparing briefs, assessments and gap analyses in collaboration with constituents. Key actions would comprise of : Promoting ratification of core and technical conventions aligned with GB and SRM TWG recommendations. Providing Technical Assistance to move to the new streamlined reporting system on ratified Conventions under Article 22 of the ILO Constitution to the ILO supervisory bodies Providing technical assistance for the implementation of supervisory body recommendations and facilitating reporting, especially for Workers' representatives. Implementing targeted interventions to protect vulnerable worker groups, ensuring a rights-based approach to labour governance. Reactivating social dialogue mechanisms, addressing legal gaps, and ensuring compliance with internation
